c:capability.name: Automation
c:capability.c:description: Model of an automation chain: a composable starting point, conditions, and actions that users build step-by-step.

c:attribute.name: description
c:attribute.description: User provided description of the automation

c:attribute.name: created
c:attribute.description: Timestamp that the automation was created

c:attribute.name: modified
c:attribute.description: Timestamp that the automation was last modified

c:attribute.name: state
c:attribute.description: The current state of the automation

c:attribute.name: conditions
c:attribute.description: The guard conditions that must be true for actions to execute

c:attribute.name: actions
c:attribute.description: The actions to execute when the trigger fires and conditions are met

c:attribute.name: lastExecuted
c:attribute.description: Timestamp of the last time the automation executed

c:method.name: Enable
c:method.description: Enables the automation if it is disabled

c:method.name: Disable
c:method.description: Disables the automation if it is enabled

c:method.name: ListHistoryEntries
c:method.description: Returns a list of all the history log entries associated with this automation

c:parameter.name: limit
c:parameter.description: The maximum number of events to return (defaults to 10)

c:parameter.name: token
c:parameter.description: The token from a previous query to use for retrieving the next set of results

c:return.name: nextToken
c:return.description: The token to use for getting the next page, if null there is no next page

c:return.name: results
c:return.description: The entries associated with this automation
